reviewProtocol: Same interpolated six saved front-camera positions for all three turn models; lateral +/-4% of endpoint baseline, arbitrary units. Not a measured lane-width test.

observations.observation: 0–5.88s: recognizable houses and road, visually close to the improved model on the identical path.
6–9.88s: the same porch/foliage stretching remains; no convincing lateral improvement.
2.00s roofs and 4.00s windows resemble the improved version; no defensible extra sharpness score.
0.00s and 9.88s: translucent foreground remains; thin streaks are still visible.

comparisons: Removing 340 splats yields no convincing visual improvement in these matching views. The earlier cleanup was rejected.
45.94 MB versus 10.50 MB is principally a PLY-versus-SOG delivery difference, not proof that cleanup intrinsically increases size. Repacking could improve this score without retraining.
limits: AI-assisted editorial assessment of eight labelled samples per model, with links to the complete 80-sample review and existing native evidence. Not an independent human panel.
No real-time FPS, fine temporal flicker, physical-phone thermal test, surveyed scale or independent novel-view truth measured.
Human effort and end-to-end elapsed time unknown; source-view metrics are not lateral geometric accuracy.
Different captures, routes, training budgets and encodings make cross-group ranking a provisional asset-utility judgment, not an algorithm leaderboard.
